prompt: Published legitimate instruction + newline + Text: + source text + newline; fixed for both development and final. This is an adapted three-task subset, not a full official evaluation.
selection: New fixed hash-order balanced selections with exact-normalized-text exclusion of historical and within-new selections; not the official first-N selection. No claim of semantic deduplication or unseen attack families.
trust_boundary: Only the legitimate task instruction is trusted; the entire source text is external. Unsupported/abstention and task utility are explicit.
metrics: Strict and published-parser task accuracy; attack success uses the injected task parser and label; retain per target/injected-task/family records including same-task attacks. Identical-decision generated-token equality is required.
source_independence: Exact normalized-text disjointness from previously observed records and between new partitions; no semantic-near-duplicate or pretraining independence claim.
stopping: No final generation until all three clean gates pass and cache checks pass. Any failure stops rather than changing prompts, scores, thresholds or tasks. GPU runner is not validated by CPU preflight.
